title: Online game state diagram
description: One online game in the D1 table games (kind online): its result and draw_offer. Every change comes from a player's POST games/{id}/action, which the game's GameRoom runs one at a time through RoomCore: applyAction decides, saveGame writes only if the row's updated time is unchanged (otherwise 409 "The board changed; try again." with the current game), and the new game goes to both players' WebSockets. Each accepted action also appends to the transcript (game_events). Only the game's two players may act (403 otherwise). A game against the computer is inserted already finished by POST games/computer and never changes; the reason abandoned exists in the types but no code sets it.
machine: games.result and games.draw_offer for kind online (worker/schema.sql), changed only by applyAction (worker/actions.ts) inside the game's GameRoom

states.description: result = '*', draw_offer NULL. Inserted when an invitation is accepted, with a start entry.
result = '*', draw_offer = the side that offered; only the other side can accept or decline.
result is 1-0, 0-1 or 1/2-1/2 with its reason, draw_offer NULL, and an end entry in the transcript. Chat still works.

transitions.guard: ply is the number of moves so far, it is the player's turn, chess.js finds it legal, and the board does not end the game
transitions.action: Append the move; log a move entry.

transitions.guard: as above, and the board ends the game: checkmate, stalemate, insufficient material, threefold repetition or fifty moves
transitions.action: Append the move; log move and end entries.

transitions.guard: a stale ply, not the player's turn, an illegal move, or no offer to answer

transitions.action: draw_offer = the player's side; log a draw-offer entry.
The other side wins, reason resign; log resign and end entries.

transitions.guard: from the side that did not offer
transitions.action: 1/2-1/2 by agreement; log an end entry.

transitions.guard: from the side that did not offer
transitions.action: draw_offer = NULL; log a draw-decline entry.

transitions.guard: a legal move on the player's turn that does not end the game
transitions.action: draw_offer = NULL (a move refuses the other side's offer and withdraws one's own); log a move entry.

transitions.guard: a legal move that ends the game

transitions.action: The other side wins; log resign and end entries.

transitions.guard: a stale ply, not the player's turn or an illegal move; or an offer, acceptance or refusal from the side that offered
transitions.action: 409 with the error ("You have already offered a draw." for a second offer); nothing saved.
